parameters.name: DtsInstanceID
parameters.description: The instance ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or subscribe instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the task resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SyncSubJobHistory
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return information about all synchronization subtasks. Default value: **false**, which returns only the synchronization subtask that is in progress or the most recently executed synchronization subtask.

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- The value **Reverse** takes effect only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the task is a zero-ETL task. Valid values:
- **true**: The task is a zero-ETL task.
- **false**: The task is not a zero-ETL task.
